scope.description: Repo override for the memory scope used by rules, search and new notes. Otherwise uses the device memory-scopes.json alias for the normalized shared checkout folder name, then that folder name.

idPattern.description: The project's record id shape, N for each digit: D-NNN, ADR-NNNN.

highest.description: The highest number the project already uses.

levels.description: The level a new note gets when the caller does not say one. required: refuse and name both levels. nearest: project when the call is inside a project, device otherwise. project or device: always that level. Left out, a level is required.

agent.description: For an agent (MCP, skills, hooks, any non-interactive caller).
